title: Earth Zoom
description: An earth zoom is a continuous or apparently continuous rush from satellite scale down to a face, continent to street to person. Nested geography collapses along one axis; a smooth zoom is not proof of real travel speed.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Start from the planet. Introduce a person as a point on Earth, or punch a joke from cosmos to porch.
Landmarks should shrink in order: cloud, coast, grid, roof, face. Once per film is plenty.
A conversation does not need the planet. A generic aerial that never reaches the person is not this.
A crash zoom that starts on a rooftop is not this. Keep identity stable from wide to tight or the face at the end is a stranger.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Design nested environments and scale transitions in 3D or compositing. Preserve direction and visual anchors.
Name the start as satellite or stratosphere, the end as eyes or feet, the path as one continuous zoom. Do not add a pan or an orbit on the way down.
Prompt: Earth zoom into [Subject], satellite to street in one rush, the planet collapsing into a face.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to place a person on Earth in one rush, or as a scale gag. Do not use it to open a dialogue scene.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Contact's opening withdraws from Earth into larger cosmic scales (the reverse direction of the same grammar). Powers of Ten runs outward and inward from a picnic.
The Simpsons couch gags punch from cosmos to porch. Reverence and joke are the same funnel.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Satellite to face, one axis. Still: Earth zoom into [Subject], satellite to street in one rush, the planet collapsing into a face.
Video: A zoom from orbit down onto [Subject], continent to street to face. Ordered landmarks.
No pan. Identity held.

Begin on a dew drop on one leaf. Pull backward continuously through the garden, neighborhood, coastline and cloud layer, ending above the planet. Keep one coherent outward axis, smooth logarithmic-feeling changes in scale and consistent daylight. Build as matched scale segments with composited handoffs; no random galaxy substitutions.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a generic aerial or a rooftop crash zoom. The tell: you cannot feel continents, or the face at the end is a new person.
The fix: start at orbit, collapse nested scales in order, keep identity.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Earth Zoom in film?
An earth zoom is a continuous scale rush from satellite or orbit down to a person, continent to street to face, along one axis.
Earth Zoom vs Aerial Push In
An aerial push approaches from the air inside a location. Earth zoom starts at planetary scale and collapses nested geographies until a face is the map.
When should I use Earth Zoom?
Use it to place a person on Earth, or as a scale gag. Do not use it for a conversation.
How do I prompt Earth Zoom for AI image or video?
Write orbit to street to face on one axis. Example: Earth zoom into [Subject], satellite to street in one rush, the planet collapsing into a face.
